Is Cincinnati's oldest bar really haunted? You can see for yourself this spooky season

Digital Media Manager

CINCINNATI —

Is Cincinnati's oldest bar really haunted?

Established in 1861, stories have been circulating about downtown Cincinnati's Arnold's bar for decades.

Something strange happens in the nighttime hours inside the bar, particularly on its second floor.

ABOVE VIDEO: Inside some of Cincinnati's most haunted spots

Employees and customers alike have reported seeing shadowy figures, and there are mysterious bumps, knocks and clanks after hours – long past closing time.

The East 8th Street bar has been subject to several paranormal investigations.

Over the years, the bar has opened its doors to the public for overnight public paranormal investigations.

Now, owners shared they're doing it one more time.

Groups can investigate the entire building, including the basement.

The offer is available Sundays and Mondays when they are closed. It will cost $600 per group for up to 10 people.

Those interested can book one of the following eight dates in October, but on Oct. 31 they close the books.

  • Oct. 4, 5, 11, 12, 18, 19, 25, 26
